text: ok and then for a model like /home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/data/models/props/08_Porschegt3rs it has a glb stored but do we need it still
resolution: Answered whether stored .glb/.obj source files are still needed in model packages: no, once a package has a saved mesh/doc.blob — the saved meshdoc beats the source file everywhere (resolveViewer render path, Outliner import, part seeding); the stored source is only a fallback for never-saved packages. Audited the tree: 6 packages carried a source file alongside a saved doc (58MB dead weight, the Porsche glb alone 27MB) — removed them, committed 329fa6fe0. 5 packages (Bus, Desk, three Nug imports) have NO saved doc, so their glb IS their only geometry — left intact and flagged to the user; opening and saving each once would convert them to meshdoc form and free those too. Manifests keep an inert viewerPath pointing at the removed file — never read while a doc exists.
